description: This is an HTML source file that implements a web-based database viewer interface. It contains layout styles, UI components, and client-side JavaScript for fetching and displaying database, table, and data information.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases from the backend API and displays them in the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases, resetting current selections and reloading the database list.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Shows or hides the tables list for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches the list of tables for a selected database and displays them.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and renders the data rows for a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Builds and inserts an HTML table from data fetched from the backend.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates individual table cell HTML, handling different data types including objects and large text.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses a cell to show full content when truncated.
